name: OSRS Raw Materials Index
description: Equal-weighted, liquidity-capped basket of gathered inputs: ores, logs, hides and raw fish. Tightest spreads of the four baskets (1.03% median) and the worst replication profile, because low unit prices against fixed buy limits make per-window notional tiny.
notes: Pure essence (2 gp) is deliberately excluded. At that price integer rounding dominates: it printed a -66.7% spread over 24h, which is a rounding artefact, not a market. The 50gp floor in UniverseParams exists for this case.
Willow logs (0.02B gp/24h, 0.3M gp per 4h window) is excluded for the same reason in reverse -- nothing about it is replicable.
Only Runite ore (46.4M) and Red dragonhide (24.8M) clear the 20M gp per-window notional floor. This basket is essentially unreplicable physically, which makes it a read-only index or nothing.
Raw materials are the most exposed to Jagex supply-side updates: a single change to a gathering method or drop table can reprice a constituent 30% in a day with no market cause.

The candidate pool is deliberately larger than target_size. Membership is decided each review by liquidity rank with entry/exit buffers, so the pool defines what the basket is ABOUT while the rules decide what it HOLDS. Curation cannot be automated away: the API has no item taxonomy.
